subject: Error during installation of aroma on Linux

messages.author: 28dfb648fee225ef
messages.subject: Error during installation of aroma on Linux
parts:
Hi All:

I am a new user of aroma.affymetrix. When I tried to install the
package on the linux server, I have following error message:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix")
Searching for locally installed packages...Error: subscript out of
bounds

The R version on the linux server is:

platform x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
arch x86_64
os linux-gnu
system x86_64, linux-gnu
status
major 2
minor 7.0
year 2008
month 04
day 22
svn rev 45424
language R
version.string R version 2.7.0 (2008-04-22)

However, I was able to install the package under Windows successfully
and my R version under Windows is:

platform i386-pc-mingw32
arch i386
os mingw32
system i386, mingw32
status
major 2
minor 6.2
year 2008
month 02
day 08
svn rev 44383
language R
version.string R version 2.6.2 (2008-02-08)

I have very some large data set to run under Linux, so I wonder if
anyone can help me with this problem. Thank you so much!

Rachel Jia

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error during installation of aroma on Linux
parts:
Hi,

I don't know why you have problems on your Linux box. Can you install
packages from, say, Bioconductor on that machine?

For troubleshooting, does the following work, or where does it go wrong?

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R");
hbLite("R.methodsS3");
hbLite("R.oo");
hbLite("R.utils");
hbLite("aroma.core");
hbLite("aroma.affymetrix");

/Henrik

messages.author: 28dfb648fee225ef
messages.subject: Re: Error during installation of aroma on Linux
parts:
It turned out the problem was caused by the incorrect installation of
some other packages on my Linux server. Now I can install
aroma.affymetrix after re-installing them. Thanks very much for your
help, Henrik.

Rachel
